message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function that talks directly to VirusTotal, so I can’t pull the data for you in real time.  
What I can do is walk you through the exact request you’d need to make (or paste into a script) and show you what the response will look like when you hit the API yourself.

---

## 1. Build the request

| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| **Endpoint** | `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/files` | The “files” endpoint supports filtering by communicating IP. |
| **Query string** | `?communicating_ip=178.34.55.101&limit=15&cursor=next_set` | `limit` caps the number of results per page; `cursor` tells VT to start from the next page. |
| **Headers** | `x-apikey: <YOUR_SUPER_API_KEY>` | Replace `<YOUR_SUPER_API_KEY>` with your actual key. |
| **Method** | `GET` | |

### Example `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/files?communicating_ip=178.34.55.101&limit=15&cursor=next_set" \
  -H "x-apikey: YOUR_SUPER_API_KEY"
```
